inputs.text: They want us focused on Ms Mary Ngechi Ngethe, the Technical Evaluation Committee chair, as if one person explains how Ksh.283 million was spent on land deemed unsuitable for a cemetery. The court’s finding that she played a central role may be true, but it also makes a convenient way to contain the story: recover the money from a committee member and leave the wider machinery behind the purchase out of view. Who benefits from keeping the blame there?
